teaser.text: Baidu is a Chinese internet and artificial-intelligence company that turns attention, computing, content and transport into sales. To understand its business, follow a dollar from the customer who pays it to the chips, programmes, vehicles and people that consume it.

stock.title: Baidu stock forecast
stock.meta_description: Baidu’s weighted scenario points to a measured recovery, with AI cash generation, valuation and risks deciding the outcome.
stock.opening: Baidu’s weighted price is HKD85.13 at October 2027 and HKD107.94 at October 2029, including dividends. It hinges on AI Cloud growth supporting the expected 2027 operating-profit recovery while advertising remains under pressure.
stock.closing: The full memo also examines Baidu’s business, rivals, management and risks.

blocks.heading: Where could Baidu’s shares be by 2029?

paragraphs.text: At October 2027, the weighted price is HKD85.13, an 8% return including dividends. At October 2028, it is HKD93.16, an 18% return. At October 2029, it reaches HKD107.94, a 37% return.

The 2029 range is HKD36.10 to HKD212.29. Today’s reference price is HKD79.45. The base case has 52% probability, making it the central path. The bear case has 30% and the bull case 18%, so the forecast gives more weight to gradual recovery than to either collapse or a rapid rerating.

blocks.heading: What has to go right or wrong for Baidu?

paragraphs.text: The base path assumes AI Cloud growth supports the expected 2027 operating-profit recovery, but that investment limits margin expansion. AI Cloud Infra revenue grew 50% year over year in Q2 2026, while online marketing revenue fell 19%; management expects cloud growth to continue but says marketing remains under pressure. The bear case gives greater weight to the 31% EBITDA fall in 2025 and the cash gap created by investment. The bull case requires paid workloads, better cloud margins and stable search monetization, which remain unproven.

blocks.heading: How much cash does Baidu really make?

paragraphs.text: Stock compensation adds another ownership cost. Employees receive shares instead of cash, so current cash is preserved, but existing shareholders receive a smaller claim on future profits unless the company buys back shares to offset the dilution. A specialist therefore examines both reported free cash flow and a measure that deducts stock pay. AI infrastructure and Apollo Go also require spending whose maintenance and expansion components are not yet separately clear.

blocks.heading: What does an investor pay for Baidu today?

paragraphs.text: Book value offers another warning. A 0.7x price-to-book ratio means the market price is below recorded net assets, but research, software and user relationships created inside the company may have been expensed rather than recorded as assets. The discount is therefore not automatically a bargain. A 0.0% dividend yield also shows that financial assets are not yet an established income stream.

earnings.title: Baidu earnings: guidance and what to watch
earnings.meta_description: Baidu's next results are expected on November 24, 2026; guidance points to AI Cloud growth, persistent advertising pressure and cash conversion.
earnings.opening: Baidu's next results are expected on November 24, 2026. Baidu's key test is whether AI Cloud growth is becoming cash generation.
earnings.closing: The full Baidu memo also answers questions about its business, rivals, management and risks.

blocks.heading: What has Baidu guided for the year?

paragraphs.text: Baidu’s promise is clear about direction but vague about the finish line. Its AI Cloud business, which rents computing capacity to customers, expects strong growth in the second half of 2026 and room to accelerate. Management says that growth should come from both new customers and larger commitments by existing ones.

Advertising is moving in the opposite direction. Baidu expects pressure to persist because chatbots and social platforms compete for attention, while its new AI search experience deliberately limits advertising until the product becomes more useful.

blocks.heading: Has Baidu kept its past promises?

paragraphs.text: Baidu completed the Hong Kong listing on September 1, 2026, after management had said completion was expected within the year. Its US$5 billion buyback authorization through 2028 is different: it permits repurchases but does not require management to spend the full amount. The dividend policy similarly allows possible distributions rather than promising a fixed payment.

blocks.heading: What have Baidu's last eight quarters shown?

paragraphs.text: The June 2026 quarter showed better operating cash collection, but continued revenue pressure and a much heavier investment bill.

blocks.heading: What should Baidu watchers look for next?

paragraphs.text: The next results should show whether AI Cloud growth is becoming cash generation. Investors should read cloud revenue, advertising income and operating cash flow together: faster cloud sales will be less reassuring if equipment spending accelerates even faster.
